p1=[[1,1,1,1],[1,1,8,1],[1,8,1,1],[1,1,1,1]]
p7=[[7,7,7,7,7,7],[7,8,7,7,7,7],[7,7,7,7,7,7],[7,7,7,7,7,7],[7,7,7,7,8,7],[7,7,7,7,7,7]]
def tile(pattern, pc, donor, core=6):
    arr=[[donor]*core for _ in range(core)]
    off=(core-len(pattern))//2
    offc=(core-len(pattern[0]))//2
    for i,row in enumerate(pattern):
        for j,v in enumerate(row):
            arr[i+off][j+offc]=pc if v==pc else donor
    return [[donor]*(core+2)] + [[donor]+r+[donor] for r in arr] + [[donor]*(core+2)]
a=tile(p1,1,5); b=tile(p7,7,6)
out=[a[i]+b[i] for i in range(8)]
print(out)
